title: BusinessFunction
description: TOGAF-sourced mechanism archetype — a unit of business behavior performed by an Organization Unit or Actor (Structure). The causal logic inside a human/organizational Structure. Extends Mechanism with TOGAF Business Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Business Function (Content Metamodel, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Content Framework).

functionDomain.description: Business functional domain (e.g., 'sales', 'finance', 'hr', 'operations', 'marketing', 'legal', 'it', 'procurement'). TOGAF mapping: Business Function domain classification.

automationLevel.description: Degree of automation of this business function. TOGAF mapping: Business Function automation assessment.
